---
title: "Overall survival, unadjusted — fitting"
subtitle: "Randomised group as the only covariate, observed data"
format: html
---

- Zero follow-up is dropped from fitting, as in the adjusted models.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(posterior)
library(knitr)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "02-overall-survival", "09-unadjusted", "results")
model_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")
trace_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "trace-plots")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(trace_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
) |>
  select(
    id,
    tx,
    survival_time_days,
    event_death,
    survival_time_days_unrestricted,
    status_death_unrestricted
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()

formulas <- list(
  "ph-182" = Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~ tx,
  "nph-182" = Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~
    tve(tx, df = 3, degree = 3),
  "ph-unrestricted" = Surv(
    survival_time_days_unrestricted,
    status_death_unrestricted
  ) ~ tx,
  "nph-unrestricted" = Surv(
    survival_time_days_unrestricted,
    status_death_unrestricted
  ) ~ tve(tx, df = 3, degree = 3)
)

# Offsets 100-400 keep these seeds apart from the main-model seeds
# (survival + multiples of 1000).
seeds <- config$seeds$survival + c(
  "ph-182" = 100,
  "nph-182" = 200,
  "ph-unrestricted" = 300,
  "nph-unrestricted" = 400
)

# Convergence rule of the main OS diagnostics (non-finite values ignored).
diagnostics_pass <- function(diagnostics) {
  finite_rhat <- diagnostics$rhat[is.finite(diagnostics$rhat)]
  finite_bulk <- diagnostics$ess_bulk[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_bulk)]
  finite_tail <- diagnostics$ess_tail[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_tail)]

  all(finite_rhat <= config$diagnostics$max_rhat) &&
    all(finite_bulk >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_bulk) &&
    all(finite_tail >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_tail)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-models
#| include: false

for (model in names(formulas)) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%s.rds", model))
  if (file.exists(model_path)) next

  model_formula <- formulas[[model]]
  fitting_data <- cohort |>
    filter_out(.data[[all.vars(model_formula)[1]]] == 0)
  ph_model <- str_starts(model, "ph")
  iterations <- if (ph_model) 2000L else 1000L

  # A fit that fails the convergence rule is refitted once with twice the
  # iterations and a new seed.
  for (attempt in 1:2) {
    seed <- seeds[[model]] + (attempt - 1L) * 500000L

    # PH: priors of the main model; time-varying: rstanarm defaults, as in
    # the adjusted time-varying models.
    fit <- if (ph_model) {
      stan_surv(
        formula = model_formula,
        data = fitting_data,
        basehaz = "ms",
        basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
        prior = normal(location = 0, scale = 0.55),
        prior_intercept = normal(0, 20),
        prior_aux = dirichlet(1),
        chains = 4L,
        cores = 4L,
        iter = iterations,
        warmup = iterations %/% 2L,
        seed = seed
      )
    } else {
      stan_surv(
        formula = model_formula,
        data = fitting_data,
        chains = 4L,
        iter = iterations,
        warmup = iterations %/% 2L,
        cores = 4L,
        basehaz = "ms",
        basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
        seed = seed
      )
    }

    if (diagnostics_pass(summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit)))) break
    iterations <- 2L * iterations
  }

  saveRDS(fit, model_path, compress = "xz")
}
```

## Convergence

```{r}
#| label: check-models
#| echo: false

fits <- names(formulas) |>
  set_names() |>
  map(\(model) readRDS(file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%s.rds", model))))

diagnostics <- fits |>
  imap(\(fit, model) {
    summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit)) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      mutate(model = model)
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

write_parquet(diagnostics, file.path(results_dir, "diagnostics.parquet"))

passed <- diagnostics |>
  split(~model) |>
  map_lgl(diagnostics_pass)
if (!all(passed)) {
  stop("OS posterior diagnostics failed: ", str_flatten_comma(names(passed)[!passed]))
}

iwalk(fits, \(fit, model) {
  trace_variables <- str_subset(colnames(as.matrix(fit)), "^tx")
  save_figure(
    plot_traces(trace_draws(fit, trace_variables), ncol = 2),
    file.path(trace_dir, sprintf("trace-%s.png", model)),
    height = 4
  )
})

diagnostics |>
  summarise(
    maximum_rhat = max(rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    minimum_ess_bulk = min(ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    minimum_ess_tail = min(ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = model
  ) |>
  mutate(draws = map_int(fits[model], \(fit) nrow(as.matrix(fit)))) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```
